_readme: Certificates of analysis for the storefront lab-report card. Keys under 'reports' are either a product id from products.json (e.g. 'crunch-berrie') or the flattened product name used everywhere else on the site (lowercase, (bracketed) words removed, punctuation and spaces stripped) - e.g. 'Zootiez (Indica)' becomes 'zootiez'. A product with an entry here renders the full LAB REPORT card: solid accent band, method, test date, lot number and heavy-metal clearance. A product with no entry renders the hollow ESTIMATED card instead, derived from strain-db.json, and says so plainly. Only put a strain in here when you are holding the actual certificate - the card makes a claim on the shop's behalf either way, and the estimated wording is there so it never has to be a claim you cannot back. Staff can also fill these in from the console (staff.html#lab) without editing this file, which is usually easier; entries saved there sit on top of whatever is in here.

_example.note: Copy this shape into 'reports' under the product key. Every field except 'cannabinoids' is optional. Percentages are numbers, not strings. 'metals': false hides the heavy-metal clearance line for a sample that was not screened for them.

gaznivore.aroma: Spicy, peppery β-Caryophyllene leads with bright citrus from Limonene. Floral and sweet notes from trans-Nerolidol and Geranyl Acetate add an elegant, fruity finish.
